answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 19339 Country: India Title: Suppose a clothe is kept in the sunlight to dry it out after wash. It is forgotten to pick it up during day time and it is there outside through out the entire night. Please let me know whether we need to wash this clothe once again next day. Question: Suppose a clothe is kept in the sunlight to dry it out after wash. It is forgotten to pick it up during day time and it is there outside through out the entire night. Please let me know whether we need to wash this clothe once again next day. Answer ID: 19339 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 172/L=26/TL=1431) It is not necessary to wash the cloth the next day. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
